purpose: Full fixed snapshot expansion with unchanged training hyperparameters. No test-guided tuning.
test_policy: Only new game IDs in the test split are scored; all earlier test games remain saved and are not promoted to train/validation.

closed_loop.sampling: Categorical policy, temperature1, fixed per-episode RNG; declared before first real training. Argmax offline metrics remain separate.
closed_loop.previous_checkpoint_baseline: After full-data training freezes, run v1 model on the exact same new cases for paired comparison; no further selection.

limitations_to_measure: expert and ordinary source seats must not be conflated
fixed decision grid versus exact source events
reconstructed state drift and native action refusals
strength only against declared simulated opponents
